title: MaxFitCalib-Bench: Controlled Audit of an LLM Calibration Benchmark Prototype
oneLiner: A frozen engineering methods artifact documenting how an LLM evaluation protocol failed safely.
keyTakeaways: The artifact specifies 126 fitness-advice questions, a UCS taxonomy, deterministic evaluator logic, and a frozen execution protocol.
The v0.1 scientific execution failed: 72 request attempts produced zero outputs that passed the frozen parser and zero interpretable scientific outputs.
The v0.2 gate stopped execution during provider preflight before any scientific scenario calls occurred.
Precision Illusion prevalence, model differences, human effects, and intervention need were not established. The final status is ENGINEERING TEST ONLY — SCIENTIFIC DIRECTION CLOSED.
hciRelevance: Demonstrates why execution contracts, fail-fast gates, provenance, and strict exclusion rules are necessary before interpreting LLM evaluation outputs.

faq.q: Did this project validate Precision Illusion?
faq.a: No. Static construct formalization and evaluator validation were completed, but the scientific execution failed and yielded zero interpretable scientific outputs.
It is retained as a bounded engineering methods artifact about parser contracts, provider schema compatibility, execution accounting, authorization provenance, and fail-fast research infrastructure.

faq.q: Will the benchmark be executed again?
faq.a: No further scientific model execution is planned under this direction.

reproducible.quickStart: Review controlled-audit-v0.2/closure/FINAL_EXECUTION_FORENSICS.md; do not treat the repository as an executable scientific benchmark.

changelog.event: Scientific direction closed as ENGINEERING TEST ONLY after v0.1 failed and v0.2 aborted before scientific calls.
Provider preflight detected a strict-schema incompatibility and correctly blocked scientific execution.
Attempted execution failed parser, provider, identity, accounting, terminal-state, and stop-rule requirements.
